# AI-Letter — Full Product & Knowledge Context

> AI-Letter (`https://ailetter.pro`) is a web-based AI career suite helping job seekers and freelancers tailor cover letters, build ATS-friendly CVs, audit resumes against job descriptions, practice STAR interviews, and track job applications across English, Ukrainian, German, and Italian.

---

## 1. Product Architecture & Core Modules

### 1.1 AI Cover Letter Generator
- Generates personalized, cliché-free cover letters in ~30 seconds matched to the candidate's CV profile and target job description.
- Supports 16+ visual templates with A4 PDF export.
- Enforces strict anti-cliché rules (avoids weak openings such as "I am writing to apply..." or vague self-labels like "results-driven team player") and integrates concrete metrics and company-specific context.
- Supports adjustable tone (`Professional`, etc.), length (`Short`, `Standard`, `Detailed`), career level (including `Senior-Executive` strategic mode), and automatic or manual language selection (`Auto`, `English`, `Ukrainian`, `German`, `Italian`).

### 1.2 Interactive CV Maker (Resume Builder)
- Supports 10 structured resume sections: Contact & Header, Summary/About Me, Work Experience, Projects, Skills, Education, Languages, Certifications, Courses, Awards, Publications, and Interests.
- Includes voice dictation support, multi-resume management, dynamic localization of template headers (`EN`, `UK`, `DE`, `IT`), dual-column vertical layout ordering, and print-ready A4 PDF & DOCX export.
- Multimodal AI CV Parser (`parseCV`) extracts structured profile fields from uploaded PDF resumes in their original language.

### 1.3 ATS CV Optimizer, Keyword Scanner & Brutal Recruiter CV Roast
- Available both inside the Dashboard (`analyzeCV`) and publicly without registration at `/ats-resume-checker` (`en`, `/uk`, `/de`, `/it`).
- Compares a candidate's PDF or pasted CV against a target job description.
- Produces a quantitative `atsScore` (0–100) and breakdown (`keywords`, `metrics`, `structure`), separates `matchedKeywords` and `missingKeywords`, offers actionable CV checklist tips, and rewrites bullet points using `[X%]` placeholders when real metrics are missing.
- **Brutal 6-Second Recruiter Roast Mode:** evaluates resumes candidly as a senior technical recruiter, highlighting top rejections and quick wins with a downloadable PNG shareable score card.

### 1.4 STAR Interview Preparation
- Generates 8 personalized behavioral and technical interview questions and structured model answers following the **STAR** method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) grounded in the candidate's CV and target vacancy.

### 1.5 Smart Kanban Job Tracker & 1-Click Job Clipper Bookmarklet
- Visual pipeline (`Applied`, `Interview`, `Offer`, `Rejected`) inside the Dashboard.
- Tracks application dates, notes, and triggers automated follow-up reminders with AI-drafted follow-up messages.
- Includes a browser **1-Click Job Clipper Bookmarklet** allowing candidates to clip any job posting directly from LinkedIn, Djinni, Indeed, Work.ua, or Upwork into AI-Letter.

---

## 2. Pricing & Plans
- **Free Plan (€0 / forever):**
  - 5 AI generations per month (no credit card required).
  - +2 bonus generations for each referred friend who signs up.
  - Access to the Resume CV Maker, basic templates, ATS keyword scanner, and Kanban job tracker.
  - Unlimited free access to public no-login utilities (LinkedIn Easy Apply message generator, Email Subject Line generator, AI role opening hook generators, Freelancer pitch generator).
- **Pro Plan (€5.99/month billed monthly, or €3.25/month billed annually at €39/year):**
  - Unlimited AI cover letter & CV generations.
  - Magic AI CV Generator from freeform text.
  - Executive Mode presets for senior leadership applications.
  - 16+ premium visual templates for CVs and cover letters.
  - Automated follow-up drafts.
  - Watermark-free HD PDF and DOCX exports.
  - Priority AI processing; 1-click cancellation anytime via Stripe.

## 3. Role-Specific Cover Letter Best Practices

### AI / ML Developer (`/cover-letter-ai-developer`)
- Highlight concrete production stack: PyTorch, JAX, Hugging Face, vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant), RAG pipelines, LangChain, and LLM fine-tuning.
- Quantify inference and cost impact (e.g., latency reduction via caching, accuracy rate on production queries).
- Mention MLOps and deployment workflows (Docker, Triton, TensorRT).

### Project Manager & Scrum Master (`/cover-letter-project-manager`)
- Quantify delivery predictability: Sprint Velocity gains, on-time milestone rates, and team sizes led.
- Show methodology mastery in context: Agile/Scrum, Kanban, RACI/DACI accountability matrices, MoSCoW prioritization, PDCA, SWOT, and Jira/ClickUp workflows.
- Position the candidate as a servant leader removing team blockers while protecting scope and budget.

### Product Manager & Product Owner (`/cover-letter-product-manager`)
- Lead with business outcomes: ARR/MRR growth, Day-7 retention lift, onboarding conversion, or churn reduction.
- Reference structured product discovery and backlog practices: Customer Journey Maps (CJM), User Stories with Acceptance Criteria, MoSCoW prioritization, and A/B experiments.
- Connect a concrete feature shipped to a product challenge facing the target employer.

### QA Engineer & SDET (`/cover-letter-qa-engineer`)
- Quantify automation ROI: regression cycle hours saved, CI feedback speed, and reduction in production bug escape rate.
- Cover the testing pyramid: E2E automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium), API testing (Postman, REST), SQL checks, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

### Frontend & React Developer (`/cover-letter-frontend-developer`)
- Tie frontend architecture to Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), bundle splitting, accessibility (WCAG), and conversion lift.
- Highlight TypeScript rigor, reusable design systems, React/Next.js, Vite, and automated UI testing.

### Data Analyst & BI Specialist (`/cover-letter-data-analyst`)
- Focus on business value of insights: reporting hours automated, churn drivers uncovered, ad spend optimization, or revenue lift.
- Specify analytical stack: advanced SQL, Python (pandas), BigQuery/Snowflake, dbt, Power BI, Looker, or Tableau.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (Multilingual)

### English
- **Is AI-Letter really free to start?** Yes — you get 5 free generations per month with no credit card required, plus unlimited access to free no-login tools like LinkedIn Easy Apply note, Subject Line, and role opening hook generators.
- **How does the ATS Resume Optimizer work?** Upload your CV and paste the target job description. AI-Letter audits formatting, calculates keyword match score, highlights missing hard skills, and rewrites bullet points with quantitative metrics.
- **What languages does AI-Letter support?** English, Ukrainian (`uk`), German (`de`), and Italian (`it`).

### Українська (Ukrainian)
- **Чи справді AI-Letter безкоштовний?** Так — ви отримуєте 5 безкоштовних генерацій щомісяця без прив'язки картки та +2 бонусні генерації за кожного запрошеного друга, а також безлімітний доступ до міні-генераторів без реєстрації.
- **Як працює ATS-оптимізатор резюме?** Ви завантажуєте PDF-резюме та вставляєте текст вакансії. ШІ перевіряє структуру, знаходить пропущені ключові слова та переписує досягнення з конкретними метриками для проходження ATS-фільтрів рекрутерів.
- **Які мови підтримує сервіс?** Українська, англійська, німецька та італійська.

### Deutsch (German)
- **Ist AI-Letter kostenlos?** Ja — der Free-Plan bietet 5 kostenlose Generierungen pro Monat ohne Kreditkarte sowie sofort nutzbare Mini-Tools ohne Registrierung.
- **Wie funktioniert der ATS-Lebenslauf-Optimierer?** Sie laden Ihren Lebenslauf hoch und fügen die Stellenanzeige ein. Die KI prüft Struktur, fehlende Keywords und optimiert Erfolge mit messbaren Ergebnissen.

### Italiano (Italian)
- **AI-Letter è gratuito?** Sì — il piano gratuito include 5 generazioni al mese senza carta di credito e accesso libero ai generatori rapidi senza registrazione.
- **Come funziona l'ottimizzatore CV per ATS?** Carichi il CV e incolli l'annuncio di lavoro: l'IA analizza le parole chiave mancanti, calcola il match score e riscrive i punti elenco con metriche concrete.
